AI is rapidly rewriting the process and paperwork layer for Proofreaders And Copy Markers, but on-site judgment and professional experience still rest with people. This article breaks down the specific impact and how to respond.
Not suited to careless people, those unable to tolerate repetition, or those who avoid disputes with authors. One incorrect character can cause serious trouble, so carelessness is dangerous.

A common path is: start in data entry or as an assistant, become a proofreading assistant, independently review proofs, take responsibility for important manuscripts, then become a proofreading supervisor or move into editing.
Best suited to rigorous, careful people who remain focused and are sensitive to language. If you accept repetition and zero-error requirements, this career offers stability.
Proofreaders and copy markers lead manuscript verification and markup, coordinate wording, punctuation, and layout, and use standards and tools to find and mark errors and safeguard content quality.

paragraphs: In the morning, collect the manuscript and review applicable standards. During the day, compare it word by word, mark errors, and return changes to the editor. At midday, verify proper names and quotations. In the afternoon, standardize the layout. Before leaving, review the clean proof and prepare it for printing.

In one sentence: catch errors in text. The work includes reading, identifying errors, marking revisions, returning changes to editors, checking layout, and conducting final reviews. It combines visual scrutiny with analysis and serves as the last stage of quality control.
